Welcome to WoofDoctor on Wheels, your premier destination for captivating pet and veterinary content. Watch life-changing surgeries, heartwarming rescue stories, expert veterinary tips, and insights into the latest technology and innovation in pet wellness. 

Whether you're a devoted dog lover, a passionate cat enthusiast, or simply have a soft spot for all animals, there's something here for every pet parent.

From the comfort of your home to the streets of the Lowcountry in our mobile clinic, Dr Douglas Dean is here to share his expertise and passion for pets. Plus, Dr. Doug is a huge advocate for veterinary wellness and vettech empowerment.

Subscribe today and let's make the world a better place, one pet at a time!
